evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

quizGuardRationale: Declarations are direct and symmetric in the app, not transitive. Existing baseline declaration lists are unchanged.
学科/科目/課程 and existing subject, specialization, class/department labels have overlapping educational uses; the lesson does not flatten every educational unit into a universal hierarchy.
学会 protects academic meeting/conference and actual organization/group meanings. 世間/社会's society-at-large sense is not inferred to mean an academic association from English society.

楽器 protects specific instrument examples and the broader implement label. The particular instruments are not synonyms of one another; the generic musical-instrument label is valid for each listed instrument.
学級 protects class/group labels but does not turn the source's grade gloss into equivalence with the entire 学年.
担ぐ protects broad carry/transport and selecting a representative. Concern with luck is a separate established construction, not a literal lifting instruction.
活字 protects printed-character/text/printing labels. English type-or-style labels do not by themselves mean printing type.

活躍 protects activity, effort and vigorous/diligent-work labels including secondary mimetic uses; 活力 protects actual vitality/energy/vigor labels. Not every energetic state is the same grammatical construction or guarantees successful performance.
仮定 protects actual supposition/assumption and think/suppose meanings, not mere shared かてい pronunciation with 家庭/過程/課程.
過程 protects actual flow/course/process labels; its direct 課程 pair guards the shared English course label while explicitly distinguishing process from curriculum.
仮名 protects its katakana subtype, broader character labels and the kana-ending use. The alias identity is a different reading/entry, and 漢字 is a contrasting script category, not another kana synonym.
加熱 protects overlapping heat/warm, water-heating, flame-heating and indoor-heating labels without requiring boiling or defining a temperature threshold.
鐘/ベル protects the unqualified bell label. Same-reading 金 is not a bell.
カバー protects actual physical covering, compensation and coverage labels, not every English sense merely by resemblance.
過半数 protects majority/greater-part labels while explaining the strict threshold and contextual denominator.
被せる protects covering, pouring-over and blame labels across viewpoints and secondary senses. That does not make clothing きせる and covering かぶせる one lexical identity.
sourceAccessLimits: Inspection receipts record author retrieval, not fresh independent reviewer retrieval. Search summaries and heading-only sections are not definition verification.
Raw source records are preserved exactly. 学級's grade wording and 仮名's alias gloss are qualified against complete matching identities rather than silently repaired.
仮名/かな and source entry 1590540 agree on scripts; separate alias entry 1577090 is retained in full. No separate alias N2 level is assigned from the mismatched gloss.
Twenty new articles; three new primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs: 担/担ぐ, 課/課程, 被/被せる.

仮, 假, 兼, 器, 弧, 括, 級, 躍, 遣 and 鐘 lack character cards across principal spelling alternatives. All written primary characters remain in metadata, without speculative kanji/stroke additions or broken links.

Existing 学部, クラス, ベル, 片仮名, 送り仮名, 漢字, ピアノ and バイオリン gain narrow navigation links; 被る gains a directly relevant headwear-viewpoint comparison. Stable identities, readings, titles, easier sourced levels and original exclusion lists remain unchanged.
Complete families retain unselected historical, specialist, spelling and reading distinctions. Dictionary order and priority flags do not establish measured frequency.
Original examples are authored teaching sentences, not quoted dictionary sentences or independently attested corpus occurrences. Validation proves structure, not linguistic correctness.

correctionEvidence.provenance: Thirteen complete families for eleven forms were re-extracted after verification of both pinned JMdict source hashes. Complete spelling/reading restrictions, sense-local qualifications and inherited POS are retained, including the separate mock-exam and calling-out homographs matched by もし. Original rows, mappings, selected senses, twenty principal families, 146 initial comparison families, component records and eleven original author-inspection receipts are unchanged.

quizPairs.reason: Pour-on/pour-over overlaps the explicitly taught pouring sense 1484320:3. An indirect guard through 注ぐ does not protect this pair.
大会 includes convention/conference, not only tournament; that event label overlaps the academic-conference sense.
The actual class/lesson answer label can be accepted for an unqualified English class question. The Japanese class group and lesson remain explicitly distinct.
The existing participation label overlaps active participation explicitly included in principal 1208450:1, without making mere attendance equivalent to an active contribution.

The suffix is explicitly taught as finding it difficult to do; the actual difficult/hard-to-do label overlaps. Euphemistic unfeasibility is also recorded, but the constructions are not interchangeable.

Protect the actual simply-cannot English label. The adverb requires a negative predicate for this reading; the guard does not teach that どうしても by itself means cannot or that it takes the suffix's construction.
The actual outer-covering label and wrapping/sheath sense overlap the broad covering answer, not merely the topic of skin or leather.
The actual supposing answer label overlaps supposition/assuming in the suru use. Conditional adverb and noun/verb attachment remain distinct; the unrelated もし homographs are not the basis.
Protect the same actual supposing label directly. Exact-title deduplication between もし and もしも does not protect either from 仮定; the worst-case noun sense is not the basis.
The unmarked put-on English label does not state the shoulder-down clothing and own-wearer restrictions. The headwear/other-person construction remains distinct in Japanese.
The actual put-on label and place-on sense can describe placing something over an object. Vehicle and publication senses are not the basis.
組合 expressly includes association, not only labor union. The academic society can meet that broad label; a guard through 会 is not transitive.

teachingClarifications: 仮定 now introduces plain clause + と仮定する as one useful way to state a whole premise and explains the actual 一万円だ example. It no longer commands that every complement be a clause or that だ always appear. Both original examples and their translations remain unchanged.

The historical Nihon Kokugo Daijiten nominal-complement example supports qualifying an overbroad rule, not a modern frequency claim. The reviewer's proposed often-keeps-だ remedy and optional new XをYと仮定する lesson are not adopted.

actualEntryInspections.actualSource: Bunpro vocabulary entry and visible example sentences
actualEntryInspections.inspection: Author fetched the actual page: noun/suru/transitive definition and ordinary clause examples, plus an equation followed by と仮定する. This is an additional inspection, not the pinned N2 coverage source.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The equation example is not an inspected XをYと仮定する example and does not establish an unrestricted noun-predicate attachment rule. No frequency claim is taken from the page.

optionalLeadLimits: 仮名遣い/送り仮名 is not added as a guard: the actual labels kana orthography and kana endings after kanji describe a system and one spelling device, not overlapping answers. Their explanatory connection is retained without a whole-topic clique.

A する sentence for 括弧 and a full fooling-sense sentence for 担ぐ remain optional expansion. Their grammatical use and additional sense are already explained; no incorrect existing example or necessary construction gap was established.
A search-generated university PDF lead failed to fetch with HTTP 500 and is not verified evidence. The search summary's categorical copula rules are not adopted.
The twelve guards protect actual English answer overlap. They do not claim unrestricted Japanese substitution, equal sense frequency, measured candidate frequency or an executed app draw.
